additional_info.subject: ID0451543-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S4 170003534] Fuse FB2 is triggered CRM:02699000256
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex,
If FB2 tripped that can only mean 1 of 2 scenarios:
FB2 is not good
TB27 is not good
My idea here would be to untrip the FB2 again and see if it reoccurs:
If it doesn't reoccur, then all good for now.
If it reoccurs, I would start by replacing the FB2 and see if it works, otherwise we need to replace TB27
I cannot imagine being something other than these because if it was on the fuses that come after, only the fuse would trip.
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
